Lyrics:
Devaraja Sevyamana Pavanangri Pankajam
Vyalayagna Sutramindu Shekaram Krupakaram
Naradadi Yogivrunda Vanditam Dghambharam
Kashika Puradhinatha Kalabhairavam Bhaje
Bhanukoti Bhasvaram Bhavabdi Tarakamparam
Neelakanta Mipsithartha Dhyakam Trilochanam
Kala Kala Ambhujaksha Makshashula Maksharam
